simplesect.para: Map nature means that pointer stability isn't guaranteed. If the map is modified (keys added/removed), the binding may break or point to wrong data. Use with caution and revalidate after map changes.

UWeaponComponent handles all weapon mechanics: triggering, reloading, ammo management, jamming, and burst fire.

Key Features:
Ammo System: Supports both magazine and direct ammo source (belt-fed, etc.)
Trigger Modes: Single, auto, and burst fire
Jamming: Probabilistic weapon jams with cooldown-based unjam
Reload: Magazine-based or direct ammo replenishment
Building: Dynamic weapon generation from asset specs
Modification Slots: Supports modular weapon attachments
The component requires a UWeaponAsset and UWeaponAssetDefaultCharacteristics to function. Generated mesh components are automatically updated and attached.
